caption: The residents of our coastal town have been whispering about the need for a bit of culture since the winter frost. Finally, the long-awaited Grand Theater has opened its doors! A huge benefactor (we think we saw a thumb-sized shadow nearby) gifted it to the community. Now, the premiere is about to begin.
